title: Oracle: after the source password changed, the connection's old password fails with ORA-01017 on every retry

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: Oracle Free 23.26.3, standard gateway, one run

symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ERROR.SOURCE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE: "Error while creating connection pool for catalog <catalog>. ORA-01017: invalid credential or not authorized; logon denied". RETRY_ON_FAILURE repeated the same error.
cause: The connection holds the old password.
effect: Retries don't clear it, and the update doesn't start.
fix: Update the connection with the current password, then start an update (not run in this round).
